classes.C0: editorial/definitional project language; no external factual authority required
classes.C1: bounded ordinary illustrative example; no contested empirical inference
classes.C2: external factual/scientific statement supported by an already verified authority
classes.C3: external factual/scientific statement requiring authority verification before promotion
classes.C4: Macroscopic Life synthesis, operational rule, or framework claim; must not be presented as field consensus

authorityPolicy: No C3 sentence may enter the promotion layer.
existingNotePolicy: Existing factual sentences and their existing note burdens are not reclassified here. Pass 02 changes physical context, so R13/R14 exact-anchor validity must be requalified after materialization.
